content.comment_body: Hi, please assist me. I've forgotten my password and cannot transfer a new program to my controller because of this issue. Is there a way to remove or reset the old password? I appreciate your help. This relates to my new project at work where I'm setting up an automatic tower lamp.

Try using this password: ****. Alternatively, you can delete the protected program from your device, which will give you a fresh module without a program. There is no method to bypass the password protection for this product.
Check out guidance on how to overwrite a password-protected program in [product_name]. More details are available here: [url]. Hope this helps. Regards, [user_name]
As I know, you can clear your program and password as shown in the attached image. Best regards, [user_name]
Hello, I'm facing the same issue: I can't recall the password for the program, but I need access to it. Is there any solution? Many thanks in advance.

Really? I wrote the program for the device and recently tried opening it with [product_name] but encountered an error. I attempted to download the program, but forgot the password. This is a major issue.
Is there any other way to retrieve the program?
No, there are no alternatives. Edit: This is exactly why password protection exists.

analysis.insight_summary: Users often encounter major setbacks when they forget the password to access or update a program on their device, making program transfer or retrieval impossible. The main remedy is to delete the entire protected program, which leads to permanent data loss unless a backup is available. User frustration is evident due to no password recovery options and the strict system lockout, especially when the original program is needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to recover, reset, or bypass forgotten program passwords without risking loss of existing logic or data on the controller. They want uninterrupted access to edit or transfer their programs.
